correctness.rationale: The steady-state balances force c_i=J/k_i, e_a=E_a-s_aJ and x_i=((k_i^-+k_i)/(k_i^+k_i))J/(E_a-s_aJ). Their conservation gives F=alpha J+sum b_a J/(E_a-s_a J)-T=0 with strictly positive derivative and a unique interior root. Implicit differentiation gives J_Ea>0 and the exact cross-curvature bracket 2/J+2s_a/u_a+2s_b/u_b-K/H. K/H is a strict positive-weight average of 0 and 2s_c/u_c, proving all q=2 brackets positive. For the three-pool rational example, exact symbolic simplification reproduces B=-2P/[j(j-3)(10j-11)Q], Q>0, and a one-sign-change transformed sextic, hence one positive root; exact rational checks recover cross derivative +71805312/33856161185 at j=1/2 and -4675/1203052 at j=1. No extrapolated stability claim is needed: distinct-enzyme global convergence is credited to the primary source.

value.rationale: The number of enzyme pools is an intrinsic discrete architectural complexity measure for a conserved biochemical cycle; q=2 universal positive complementarity versus an explicit q=3 globally stable unique sign reversal is a sharp, motivated structural boundary. The exact algebraic threshold and fixed-total derivative provide reusable diagnostics beyond routine implicit differentiation. This is not a generic renaming or an arbitrary small numerical example.

limitations: Closed positive HMM mass-action cycles only, fixed substrate T and positive rates; mixed derivative is additive enzyme-total curvature, not epistasis or kinetics in free enzyme concentration.
Full historical second-order metabolic-control articles may contain an equivalent derivation, but no such coverage was positively established.
